title: 第十七章 单狐之山第十八章 诸怀之痛
lines: 第十七章：单狐之山
穿过那条充满机油味和金属摩擦声的地下甬道，三人仿佛从一台巨大的机器内部，跌入了另一个世界。
眼前豁然开朗。
不是他们预想中的地狱熔炉，而是一片被黄昏笼罩的、荒凉的山谷。夕阳将天边染成一片诡异的紫红色，将山谷两侧的黑色玄武岩山体映照得如同燃烧的煤炭。空气干燥、寒冷，带着一股浓烈的硫磺和腐肉混合的气味。
“这是……北山？”李元茜看着手中的《山海经》拓片，声音沙哑，“《北山经》第一卷：‘北山之首曰单狐之山，多机木，其上多华草。’”
“机木？”黄海涛环顾四周。山谷里确实长着不少树木，但形态极其怪异。那些树没有叶子，树干呈现出一种病态的铁灰色，表面布满了瘤状的突起，像无数个睁大的眼睛。而在树梢顶端，开着一种巨大的、像人脸般的白色花朵，在晚风中轻轻摇曳，发出类似呜咽的声响。
“那是‘华草’？”张弛缩了缩脖子，“长得可真够瘆人的。”
“不是草，是寄生植物。”李元茜走近一棵树，小心翼翼地观察那些“人脸花”，“看花瓣的纹理，那是某种真菌和植物的共生体。它在模仿人脸，可能是为了吸引特定的授粉者，或者……吓退食草动物。”
她话音刚落，那些“人脸花”仿佛听到了人声，齐刷刷地转向了三人所在的方向。那一张张“脸”上没有五官，只有五个黑洞洞的孔，在风中发出“呼呼”的声响，像是在窃窃私语。
“退后。”黄海涛低声道，手中的石矛握紧，“这东西不对劲。”
就在这时，山谷深处传来一阵急促的蹄声。
哒哒哒哒——！
声音清脆、密集，像无数颗石子在敲击地面。三人立刻躲到一块巨石后面，探头望去。
只见一群生物正以极高的速度，从山谷深处冲出来。
那是狼。
但又不是现代的任何一种狼。它们的体型比藏狼还要大上一圈，四肢异常修长，奔跑时身体几乎贴地，像一道道灰色的闪电。最诡异的是它们的头部——吻部极短，几乎看不见鼻子，而那双耳朵却大得出奇，像两把展开的折扇，在奔跑时高频颤动，显然是用来收集声波的。
“单狐……”黄海涛念出了这一卷开篇的名字，“《山海经》里说‘有兽焉，其状如狼，赤首鼠目，其音如豚，名曰单狐。’”
“赤首鼠目？”李元茜眯起眼睛，“我看它们脑袋是灰色的，眼睛也不像老鼠。”
“看它们的奔跑姿态。”黄海涛指着那群狼，“注意看它们的后腿发力方式。不是单纯的蹬地，而是有一种……弹射感。”
话音未落，领头的那头“单狐”猛地一个急停，前爪在地面上一撑，整个身体竟然像青蛙一样，凭空跳起了近三米高，一口咬住了一朵低垂的“人脸花”。
咔嚓！
花茎应声而断。那头单狐落地，甩了甩头，将那朵还在扭动的“人脸花”嚼碎吞下，喉咙里发出满足的、类似猪哼的声音。
“果然是‘其音如豚’。”李元茜打了个寒颤，“它们在吃这些寄生花。那花可能是它们的食物来源。”
“不止是食物。”张弛突然指着另一个方向，“看那边！”
在山谷的另一侧，一片稀疏的“机木”林边缘，一个身影正蹲在地上，似乎在挖掘着什么。
那是一个穿着破烂防护服的人。他动作熟练，手里拿着一把工兵铲，正在从一个土坑里往外刨着什么。当他把那东西刨出来时，三人倒吸一口凉气。
那是一具“单狐”的尸体。
但那尸体已经高度腐烂，皮肤呈现出一种诡异的绿色。而那个挖坑的人，正是他们以为已经死在悬圃爆炸里的——张弛的队友，那个负责地质勘探的“老赵”。
“老赵？”张弛忍不住喊出声。
老赵的动作猛地一顿，缓缓抬起头。他的脸在阴影里看不真切，但那双眼睛，在昏暗的光线下，反射出一种和单狐一样的、诡异的绿光。
“张……弛？”老赵的声音嘶哑，不像人声，倒像是两个金属片在摩擦。
他站起身，手里还拎着那具腐烂的单狐尸体。他没有靠近，只是站在那里，用那双绿油油的眼睛盯着他们。
“你们……也来了？”老赵的声音里带着一丝难以言喻的兴奋，“正好……我缺几个样本。新鲜的。”
他扔下那具尸体，双手从腰间抽出两把用骨头和金属片磨成的短刀，刀刃上还在滴着绿色的粘液。
“他要攻击我们！”黄海涛大吼一声，将李元茜和张弛护在身后。

Chapter 17: Mountain of Single Fox
1.
Passing through the underground tunnel filled with the smell of engine oil and the sound of metal friction, the three of them seemed to have fallen into another world from inside a huge machine.
My eyes suddenly opened up.
It was not the hell furnace they expected, but a desolate valley shrouded in dusk. The setting sun dyed the horizon a strange purple-red color, reflecting the black basalt mountains on both sides of the valley like burning coals. The air was dry and cold, with a strong smell of sulfur and rotten flesh.
"This is... Beishan?" Li Yuanqian looked at the rubbing of "The Classic of Mountains and Seas" in her hand, her voice hoarse, "Volume 1 of "The Classic of Mountains and Seas": 'The head of Beishan is called the Mountain of Single Fox, with many trees and many flowers and grasses on it.'"
"Ji Mu?" Huang Haitao looked around. There are indeed many trees growing in the valley, but their shapes are extremely weird. Those trees had no leaves, and their trunks were a sickly iron-gray color, and their surfaces were covered with knob-like protrusions, like countless wide-open eyes. And at the top of the tree, there is a huge white flower that looks like a human face, swaying gently in the evening wind, making a sound like a whimper.
"Is that 'Hua Cao'?" Zhang Chi shrank his neck, "It looks really scary."
"It's not a grass, it's a parasitic plant." Li Yuanqian walked closer to a tree and carefully observed the "Human Face Flowers". "Look at the texture of the petals. It's a symbiosis between some kind of fungus and a plant. It's imitating a human face, maybe to attract specific pollinators, or... to scare off herbivores."
As soon as she finished speaking, those "Human Face Flowers" seemed to hear the human voice and turned in the direction of the three of them. There were no facial features on the "faces", only five black holes, which made a "whooshing" sound in the wind, like whispering.
"Back off." Huang Haitao whispered, clenching the stone spear in his hand, "There's something wrong with this thing."
At this moment, there was a rapid sound of hooves deep in the valley.
Ta-ta-ta-ta-!
The sound was crisp and dense, like countless stones hitting the ground. The three people immediately hid behind a boulder and looked around.
I saw a group of creatures rushing out from the depths of the valley at extremely high speeds.
That's a wolf.
But not any kind of modern wolf. Their bodies are even larger than Tibetan wolves, their limbs are unusually slender, and their bodies almost touch the ground when they run, like streaks of gray lightning. The weirdest thing is their head - the muzzle is extremely short, and the nose is almost invisible, while the ears are surprisingly large, like two unfolded folding fans, vibrating at high frequency when running, obviously used to collect sound waves.
"Single Fox..." Huang Haitao read out the name of the opening chapter of this volume. "The Classic of Mountains and Seas says, 'There is a beast, its shape is like a wolf, with a red head and rat eyes, and its sound is like a dolphin, and its name is Single Fox.'"
"Red-headed rat eyes?" Li Yuanqian narrowed her eyes, "I think their heads are gray, and their eyes don't look like mice."
"Look at their running posture." Huang Haitao pointed at the group of wolves. "Pay attention to the way their hind legs exert force. It's not just kicking off the ground, but there is a... feeling of ejection."
Before he finished speaking, the leading "single fox" suddenly stopped suddenly, put his front paws on the ground, and his whole body jumped up nearly three meters out of thin air like a frog, and bit into a low-hanging "human face flower".
Click!
The flower stem broke at the sound. The single fox landed on the ground, shook its head, chewed up the still twisting "Human Face Flower" and swallowed it, making a satisfied sound like a pig's snort in its throat.
"Sure enough, it's 'the sound is like a dolphin'." Li Yuanqian shuddered, "They are eating these parasitic flowers. That flower may be their food source."
"It's not just food." Zhang Chi suddenly pointed in another direction, "Look over there!"
On the other side of the valley, at the edge of a sparse "machine tree" forest, a figure was squatting on the ground, seemingly digging for something.
It was a man in a tattered protective suit. He moved skillfully, holding an engineering shovel in his hand, and was digging something out of a pit. When he dug the thing out, the three of them gasped.
It was the body of a "single fox".
But the corpse was highly decomposed, and the skin showed a strange green color. And the man who dug the hole was the one they thought had died in the Xuanpu explosion - Zhang Chi's teammate, the "Old Zhao" who was in charge of geological exploration.
"Old Zhao?" Zhang Chi couldn't help shouting.
Lao Zhao paused suddenly and slowly raised his head. His face couldn't be seen clearly in the shadow, but his eyes, in the dim light, reflected a strange green light like Dan Fox.
"Zhang...relax?" Lao Zhao's voice was hoarse, not like a human voice, but like two metal pieces rubbing against each other.
He stood up, still holding the rotting corpse of a single fox in his hand. He didn't come close, just stood there, staring at them with his green eyes.
"You...are here too?" Lao Zhao's voice contained a hint of indescribable excitement, "Just so...I'm short of a few samples. Fresh ones."
He threw down the body and pulled out two short knives sharpened from bones and metal pieces from his waist. The blades were still dripping with green mucus.
"He's going to attack us!" Huang Haitao yelled, protecting Li Yuanqian and Zhang Chi behind him.
